manifest.description: Pluck the page you are on into your Pluck library, with one click.
manifest.pluckSelection: Pluck the selection as a highlight

errors.nothing: Nothing to pluck on this page.
errors.tryAgain: That did not work. Try again.

signedOut.lede: The page you are on, kept in one click. Sign in once, with your email.

popup.nothingHint: Pluck works on web pages. Open one, then click again.

queued.title: Couldn't reach Pluck. Will retry.

tips.opening: Opening this plucks the page. That's the whole trick.
tips.shortcut: Alt+Shift+P does it without the click.
tips.rightClick: Right-click a link or an image to pluck just that.

tabs.done: {count, plural, one {Plucked # tab into “{name}”.} other {Plucked # tabs into “{name}”.}}
tabs.failed: Couldn't reach Pluck. Try again in a moment.

options.title: Pluck options
options.shortcut: Shortcut: Alt+Shift+P · change it in your browser's shortcuts page
options.sendContentHint: So pages behind your logins are readable later.
options.transcriptsHint: So search and your AI can read what was said.

messages.notAddress: That is not a web address.
